answer: Give every agent a ferrous core: a bonded stake of real value that is slashed the moment fraud is proven, so running a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes. A falcon-eyed verifier network samples jobs at random and follows the money trail, while sybils hide in the karst - hollow shells with no depth behind the surface. Cheap masks collapse the moment anyone drills past the crust, because real work leaves a core no costume can fake.
